userStories.title: Initialize L1 skeleton from product corpus
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Root has 8+ L1 children covering all major product domains. validate.py passes. >=10 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L2 for Electronics and Clothing
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Electronics and Clothing each have 3-7 L2 children. NLIV > 0.35. >=30 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L2 for Home Goods and Books
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Home Goods and Books each have 3-7 L2 children. NLIV > 0.35. >=50 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L2 for remaining L1 domains
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All L1 domains have 3-7 L2 children. NLIV > 0.38. >=80 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Electronics subtree
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Electronics L2 nodes each have 2-5 L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=110 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Clothing & Accessories subtree
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Clothing L2 nodes each have 2-5 L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=130 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Home Goods subtree
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Home Goods L2 nodes each have 2-5 L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=150 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Books and Toys subtrees
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Books and Toys L2 nodes each have 2-5 L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=170 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Sporting Goods and Tools subtrees
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Sporting Goods and Tools L2 nodes each have 2-5 L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=190 nodes total.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Pet Products, Auto Parts, Cosmetics subtrees
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Remaining domains have L3 children. NLIV > 0.40. >=210 nodes total.

userStories.title: Refine: Fix weak edges (NLIV < 0.3)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Zero weak edges. NLIV mean > 0.50. Zero chains.

userStories.title: Refine: MECE audit and structural balance
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: CSC > 0.35. Branching CV < 0.8. All siblings mutually exclusive.

userStories.title: Refine: Final optimization — maximize composite
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Composite > 0.60. NLIV > 0.50. CSC > 0.35. >=200 nodes. Zero chains.
